content: Kamwahu kan en Kupwurokong
Samwa ko, kumwail rong dahme samamwail kan kin padahkihong kumwail. Kumwail rong kanahieng, kumwail ahpw pahn dehdehkihla.
Dahme I padapadahkihong kumwail me mwahu, eri, kumwail tamataman padahk pwukat koaros.
Ngehi iehros emen rehn pahpa oh nohno, eri, ni ei kekeirda,
semeio kin padahkihong ie soahng kan. E kin nda, “Tamataman dahme I ndawei oh dehr manokehla. Kapwaiada me I ndaiong uhk, ke ahpw pahn mourkihla.
Nantihong alehda kupwurokong oh erpit! Dehr manokehla de pohnsehse ei padahk kan.
Ke dehr kesehla kupwurokong, pwe ih me pahn sinsileiuk; poakohng pwe e pahn kamouruhkala.
Kupwurokong me keieu kesempwal ke en alehda. Mehkoaros likin met, pil nantihong alehda erpit.
Poakohng kupwurokong, e ahpw pahn kahrehiong uhk omw pahn lapalapala. Pwoalehdi teng, e ahpw pahn kawauwihiukala.
E pahn wiahla elin kapwat lingan ehu pohn moangomw.”
Rong ie, samwa. Rong oh ale ei padahk kan ni mehlel, ke ahpw pahn mour werei.
I padahkihonguhkehr duwen kupwurokong oh ahl pwung en mour.
Sohte mehkot pahn uh nan elomw ma ke pahn weweidwei ni loalokong, oh ke sohte pahn dipekelekel ni omw pahn tang.
Tamataman ahnsou koaros dahme ke padahngkier. Padahk kan me ke aleier iei omw mour—sinsile mwahu.
Ke dehr kohla wasa aramas suwed kan kin kohla ie. Dehr idawehn karasepen aramas suwed kan.
Dehr wia! Sohpeisang me suwed! Soikala oh wenewohng nan elomw.
Aramas suwed sohte kin kak meirla lao re wiahda me suwed. Re kin pepehd ma re sohte wiahiong emen me suwed.
Tiahk suwed oh tiahk eikek rasehng kisin mwenge oh pihl rehrail.
Ahl me aramas pwung kan kin weid loale rasehng dakadahn ketipin me kin maramarainla lao rahn pwarada.
Ahl en me suwed kan me rotorot rasehng pwohng. Re kin pwupwudi, ahpw re sohte kin kilang dahme re dipekelekelki.
Samwa, rong kanahieng dahme I nda. Rong ei koasoi kan.
Dehr mweidohng en dohsang uhk. Tamataman oh kolokol nan kapehdomw.
Padahk pwukat pahn kahrehda mour oh kakehlahda mehmen me wehwehki.
Kanahieng omw madamadau, pwe omw madamadau kan kin kahrehda mwomwen omw mour.
Dehr koasoia mehkot me sohte mehlel. Dehr kedirepwki lokaia likamw oh lokaia me kin kasalongehla aramas.
Sarada kilengwei ni likilik; dehr itiekidi ni namenek.
Koasoanehdi ni keneinei dahme ke pahn wia, oh mehkan me ke pahn wia ahpw pahn pweida mwahu.
Sohpeisang me suwed oh wenewei mwohmw. Dehr wia ehu kahk sang ni ahl pwung.
